[P2] Require the remaining error-restoration cases in tests

Removing the `AiTimeoutError`, `LlmMaxTokensError`, or `AiError` reconstruction cases leaves the added assertions unchanged: timeout tests inspect the retry callback, token-limit tests inspect the final message, and missing-package tests bypass the real step boundary. Callers would then receive `StepError` instead of the advertised classes. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the testing design and require each exported error class to survive the real operation boundary on initial execution and replay.
